name: hud_ui_message_set_value_if_owner_matches
description: HudUiMessage::SetValueIfOwnerMatches updates a selected message panel only when the owner side matches.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?SetValueIfOwnerMatches@HudUiMessage@@SIXHHM@Z at 0x412650 currently fails with 100 unmasked mismatches after masking 42 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 136 bytes, the VC object symbol is 160 bytes with 15 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, and the triage artifact is build/vc5-verify/hud_ui_message_set_value_if_owner_matches/verify/412650_byte_triage.txt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x412650 selects g_HudUiMgrMessages[messageIndex], returns when ownerSideIndex differs from the message panel owner side at offset 0x2a4, writes the one-character 0xa5 special token when valueOrClearToken equals 123456792.0f, otherwise formats ceil(valueOrClearToken) as "%d", and invalidates the message widget.
The native smoke verifies owner mismatch skip behavior, rounded numeric text update with invalidation, and special-token text update without invalidating the message widget.
